decision.rationale: The official We're Only Human TLEF project develops and evaluates generative-AI and writing materials for Faculty of Arts courses, explicitly supported by UBC Vancouver students. Its homepage identifies practical Guidance and Learning Resources, team introductions, an Evaluation Plan, scholarly reading, and News. These provide evidence for support, stories, research and news overrides within an academic teaching-and-learning host; no application-call section is shown.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly identifies News as announcements and project updates.
Our Team introduces the researchers and staff behind the project.
Guidance and Learning Resources offer principles, frameworks and usable toolkits, while Contact Us provides practical access to the project.
The Evaluation Plan describes measuring project impact; What We're Reading identifies scholarly articles and books informing its work.

fallback.rationale: The project primarily develops teaching and learning around generative AI, writing and academic integrity in Faculty of Arts courses.
